bio.text: Russ Fulcher has served in the U.S. House of Representatives since January 2019 and sits on the Energy and Commerce and Natural Resources committees.
He served 10 years in the Idaho Senate, six as Majority Caucus Chair, and spent 24 years in the high-technology industry at Micron Technology and Preco Electronics.
A fourth-generation Idahoan, he grew up on a dairy farm in Meridian and earned bachelor's and master's degrees in business from Boise State University.
